name: 16-exec
teaches: host:exec/run runs a local command: argv is a vector and never a shell string, a nonzero exit is an answer and a missing program is 127, and the scope bounds it with a deadline ceiling, a byte cap and an allow list — drt announces the wiring on stderr because granting it is leaving the sandbox.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config deploy.json'; drt run --config deploy.json
